body.p: A wolverine is leading its seven reindeer. It met a fox. The fox: "How meager are your reindeer, I have good land there, let me make [them] fat within one week." The wolverine believed [it], it gave its reindeer to the fox. The fox led the reindeer away. It went farther away, it killed the reindeer, it ate [them]. Within one week it finished the seven reindeer. A week went by, the wolverine went off, it went after the reindeer from the fox, it met the fox: "Where are my reindeer?" "I ate your reindeer, I finished [them] within one week." The fox ran off. Behind it [the wolverine] shouted, [the [DCh]: The syntax appears to be mixed fox] went to the house of the wolverine. The wolverine's wife asked: "Who is shouting?" "Daddy is shouting", the children up; maybe "d'antakiË" belongs to the first clause?!said. "I have fattened the reindeer, hang up a bell on my tail", the fox said. They attached a bell, the fox ran off. Going it met a jay. "Let's spend the spring together", the fox says. They started to spend the spring. [GVY:] The original translation 'Let's go together' seems incorrect (maybe it comes from a confusion of nÊ¼ÉÅnÊ¼É- 'spend a spring' and ÅÉnÉ- 'go'). "Well, man, let's sail downstream, away from the ones living [here]". They sailed off. "Let me sleep, you steer". The fox fell asleep. "Man", he said, "you sleep". The jay fell asleep, the fox went upstream, it went up river, it passed by its tent. It went again downstream. "Man, get up, it's boring, let's talk". They are sailing, the jay says: "Man, look, there are landing places of people". They landed at their landing places, the fox said and persuaded [the jay]: "Don't be afraid, shoot even more, for that they don't say anything, kill [them]". There the jay said: "You stalk that tent, let me stalk this one". They divided the tents. They started stalking, the fox shot in the middle pole [of a tent]. The jay saw [DCh]: Form "á»¥lÉËkitpi" is not really clear.that it had killed its children, there it started crying. It was crying for three years, until it turned brown. Then autumn came, the glacies started to freeze, the jay is jumping [on the ice]. The fox said: "Man, you'll go upriver". The fox ran along the traces of the jay, it fell [into the water]. It shouted to the jay: "Give me a snag". The jay was foolish, it gave a snag. The fox went out along the tree, it ran off. The jay disappeared [in the pool].
